name: Archboard announcements
responsibility: Archboard's context changes as the voice agent announces them: each settled board change, and each focus or selection a pane reports
description: It keeps one Semantic context publisher per tab session and announces each event it publishes. A settled change's brief goes to the workhorse of the board's checkout, withheld once the brief is stale. The voice hears the news of a board on screen, as speech when it stops the narration, and nothing of a board no pane shows. The coordinator hears only what an agent outside the session did. A focus or selection the user made carries a topic, so a later one replaces it while it waits.

outgoing.label: agent.announce, one change at a time
